description: This pie chart illustrates the distribution of languages represented in the OpenAssistant Conversations dataset. The chart contains seven slices, each representing a different language. The largest slice, labeled “English,” is blue and occupies approximately 31.4% of the chart. “Spanish” is the next largest, colored a lighter blue, and represents 31.4% of the data. “Russian” is shown in a medium blue and accounts for approximately 5.7%, followed by “German” in a light teal color at 3.6%. “French” is a light purple and represents 2.9%, while “Chinese” is a light orange and occupies 1.9%. The smallest slice, labeled “Other” which includes “Catalan” and “Portuguese (Brazil)” and “Thai”, is a light pink and represents 5.8% of the total. Percentage labels are displayed inside each slice, and a legend is present to identify each language. The slices appear to be ordered clockwise, generally from largest to smallest proportion.
